headline.zh: 合并仍无协议，感恩节期间无新进展；马斯克加码赠股并称「建议继续持有」，RBC 认为公告或在 2027 年初；TSLA 周五提前收盘
headline.en: Still no merger agreement and no new progress over Thanksgiving; Musk expands the share gift and says 'hold on to your shares', RBC sees an announcement by early 2027; TSLA trades a shortened Friday session

summary.zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月 27 日（亚洲/新加坡），Tesla 与 SpaceX（SPCX）仍未宣布合并协议、换股比例或监管文件，两家公司也没有新的官方声明。美股 11 月 26 日感恩节休市，过去 24 小时没有新的合并进程报道，最新信息仍是 FT 11 月 24 日（未经公司确认）关于谈判委员会、顾问和年底目标的报道。分析师方面，RBC 的 Ken Herbert（11/24，Bloomberg Law）认为公告可能在 2027 年初，早于原先预期，并称投资者反馈显示 TSLA 持有人可能接受无溢价合并。马斯克在 X 上集中谈 SpaceX 赠股：每个美国孩子将获两股（公司一股下月转出，他个人一股待明年 6 月锁定期结束），之后每年再捐一股，并称「建议继续持有」；他还承认 SpaceX 在数字超级智能上「连铜牌都没有」。他没有谈合并。TSLA 最近收盘仍为 11/25 的 380.14 美元，11 月 27 日（周五）美东 13:00 提前收盘。
summary.en: As of 27 November 2026 (Asia/Singapore), Tesla and SpaceX (SPCX) still have no announced merger agreement, exchange ratio or regulatory filing, and no new official statements. US markets were shut on 26 November for Thanksgiving and there was no new reporting on the merger process in the past 24 hours; the latest remains the FT's 24 November report (not confirmed by the companies) on the negotiating committees, advisers and year-end target. On the analyst side, RBC's Ken Herbert (24 November, via Bloomberg Law) sees an announcement by early 2027, earlier than he expected, and says investor feedback suggests TSLA holders might accept a no-premium deal. On X, Musk focused on the SpaceX share gift: every American child gets two shares (the company's next month, his own after his lockup ends next June), plus another share every year, and he told holders 'I recommend holding on to your shares'; he also conceded SpaceX is 'not yet even on the podium' in digital superintelligence. He did not discuss the merger. TSLA's last close is still $380.14 from 25 November; Friday 27 November is a shortened session closing at 1pm New York time.

points.zh: 合并进程：过去 24 小时无新的确认或新报道（感恩节休市）。仍以 FT 11/24 报道为准（全股票、约 3.5 万亿美元、目标年底、「尚未接近达成」，未经公司确认）；AFR 11/25 转载同一报道。
points.en: Merger process: nothing new confirmed or newly reported in the past 24 hours (Thanksgiving holiday). The FT's 24 November report remains the reference (all-stock, about $3.5 trillion, year-end target, 'not close'; not confirmed by the companies); the AFR re-ran it on 25 November.

points.zh: 时间表分歧（分析师观点）：RBC 的 Ken Herbert 认为公告可能在 2027 年初（Bloomberg Law 11/24）；FT 报道的目标是年底前签约，以赶在 1 月 3 日新国会就职前。两者都不是公司表态。
points.en: Timing views differ (analyst views): RBC's Ken Herbert sees an announcement by early 2027 (Bloomberg Law, 24 November), while the FT reported a target to sign by year-end, before the new Congress sits on 3 January. Neither is a company statement.

points.zh: 溢价问题：RBC 称投资者反馈显示 TSLA 持有人可能接受无溢价合并；此前 Gary Black 估 25% 溢价需 SpaceX 增发约 52%。条款均未公布。
points.en: Premium question: RBC says investor feedback suggests TSLA holders might accept a no-premium deal; Gary Black earlier estimated a 25% premium would need about 52% new SpaceX shares. No terms have been published.

points.zh: 马斯克 X：每个美国孩子两股 SpaceX（公司一股下月转、个人一股待 2027 年 6 月锁定期结束），之后每年再捐一股；「建议继续持有」；承认 SpaceX 在数字超级智能上落后。未谈合并。
points.en: Musk on X: two SpaceX shares for every American child (the company's next month, his after his June 2027 lockup), plus one more every year; 'I recommend holding on to your shares'; concedes SpaceX trails in digital superintelligence. No merger comments.

points.zh: 日程：美股 11/27 周五提前收盘（美东 13:00，即新加坡 11/28 02:00）；欧盟 TCMV 辅助驾驶会议 12/15。
points.en: Calendar: US markets close early on Friday 27 November (1pm New York, 2am 28 November Singapore); EU TCMV Assisted Driving meeting on 15 December.

tsla_analysis.zh:
美股 11 月 26 日感恩节休市，TSLA 最近收盘仍为 11 月 25 日的 380.14 美元（-1.18%，区间 357.64–383.73 美元）；SPCX 同日收 127.44 美元（+1.30%）。11 月 27 日周五为半日交易，美东 13:00 收盘，成交通常偏清淡。本期无新的卖方评级变化可确认；RBC 关于「公告或在 2027 年初」的判断针对合并时间表，未见对 TSLA 目标价的调整。

期权方面，OptionCharts 页面显示 TSLA 30 日隐含波动率 54.38%（前次 54.65%），IV Rank 66.15%，IV 百分位 98.81%，历史波动率 65.12%，未平仓认沽/认购比 0.78；一年 IV 区间 36.84%（10/29）至 63.35%（11/20）。IV 仍处高位，卖出看跌期权的权利金较丰厚，但也反映合并条款、年底时间窗和欧盟审批的不确定性。以上为公开数据摘录，不是价格或波动率预测。
tsla_analysis.en:
US markets were closed on 26 November for Thanksgiving, so TSLA's last close is still $380.14 from 25 November (-1.18%, range $357.64–$383.73); SPCX closed at $127.44 (+1.30%) that day. Friday 27 November is a half session closing at 1pm New York time, typically on thin volume. No new sell-side rating changes could be confirmed; RBC's 'early 2027' view concerns merger timing, with no TSLA target change seen.

In options, OptionCharts shows TSLA 30-day implied volatility at 54.38% (prior 54.65%), IV Rank 66.15%, IV percentile 98.81%, historical volatility 65.12% and an open-interest put/call ratio of 0.78; the one-year IV range is 36.84% (29 October) to 63.35% (20 November). IV remains elevated, so put premiums are rich, but that also reflects uncertainty over merger terms, the year-end window and EU approval. This is a summary of public data, not a forecast of price or volatility.
